outcome: Monitoring in a neonatal care unit
cohort: The study included 845,345 singleton live births in Finland between 1996 and 2010.
finding: Treatment of maternal psychiatric disorders with SSRIs during pregnancy was associated with a lower risk of preterm birth and cesarean section but a higher risk of neonatal maladaptation.
mod_finding: Maternal SSRI treatment during pregnancy was associated with a lower risk of cesarean section compared to mothers with psychiatric disorders but no SSRI treatment.
